profile.name: Muhammad Suleet
profile.headline: I build mobile apps people love to open.
profile.summary: React Native developer with 3+ years of experience shipping 15+ production iOS and Android apps across health, e-commerce, travel, logistics and AI. I own the whole journey: Redux-driven mobile UIs, Node APIs and Firebase backends, all the way to release on the App Store and Google Play.

projects.name: ITER Travel Planner
projects.description: A travel planning app that helps users build, organize and manage trips end to end.
features: AI itinerary generation with day-by-day plans
Real-time group chat for travellers on the same trip
Subscriptions with entitlement gating across platforms

projects.name: FitFindAI
projects.description: An AI-powered fitness discovery app that surfaces tailored workouts and classes.
features: AI-matched workouts and classes for each user
Personalized fitness discovery feed
Progress tracking with smart reminders

projects.name: GasUp
projects.description: On-demand fuel delivery with live order tracking and real-time status updates.
features: On-demand fuel ordering in a few taps
Live driver tracking on the map
Saved vehicles and payment methods

projects.name: Sylenze
projects.description: A secure school video-sharing platform built for safe, private classroom content.
features: Secure, private video sharing built for schools
Role-based access for staff and students
Moderated uploads with safe playback

projects.name: Kowala

projects.name: Docucares

projects.name: RememberMe Memorial
projects.description: A digital memorial app that pairs each life story with an engraved QR plaque, so anyone who scans it can explore photos, videos and memories.

Family invites, moderated tributes, and a Memorial Plus subscription via Stripe

Photo and status reporting

projects.name: Havera

Tiered perks, streaks and challenges
Personalized offers that drive retention

In-app progress and check-ins

points: Build and ship cross-platform React Native apps for international clients
Own releases to the App Store and Google Play end to end

Delivered mobile apps and their Node/Express + MongoDB backends
Set up Redux architecture and reusable component libraries
Worked across health, logistics and education products
Built React and React Native features in a product team
Integrated REST APIs and Firebase services
Learned the craft of shipping production code

services.title: Cross-platform apps
services.description: Native-feeling iOS and Android apps from one React Native codebase: fast, reliable and store-ready.

services.title: Full-stack products
services.description: The API, database and admin tools behind your app, built with Node, Express, MongoDB and Firebase.

services.title: AI features
services.description: Chatbots, voice-to-text, recommendations and smart flows wired into shipping products.

services.title: Store releases
services.description: Signing, builds, review guidelines and launch: I take your app all the way to the App Store and Google Play.

process.title: Discover
process.description: We pin down the users, the core flows and what version one really needs.

process.title: Prototype
process.description: Clickable flows and a component system, so we test the feel before we write the code.

process.title: Build
process.description: Weekly builds on TestFlight and Play internal testing, so you see progress on your own phone.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Store listings, review and release, then analytics and iteration once real users arrive.
